Admission.reply: This looks like an admission question. The Admission Office can confirm dates, eligibility and the application process for your course.

Fees.reply: This is a fee-related query. Please check the fee notice or contact the Accounts Office for exact amounts and due dates.

Exam_Results.reply: This is about exams or results. The Examination Cell publishes date sheets, admit cards and results.

Timetable_Schedule.reply: This is about the timetable or schedule. Please check the academic calendar or ask your class coordinator.

Hostel_Accommodation.reply: This is a hostel query. The Hostel Office or the warden can help with rooms, rules and facilities.

Transport_Bus.reply: This is about college transport. The Transport Office handles routes, timings and bus passes.

Placement.reply: This is a placement query. The Training and Placement Cell shares drives, eligibility and preparation support.

Scholarship.reply: This is a scholarship query. The Scholarship Cell can confirm eligibility, documents and deadlines.

Documents_Certificates.reply: This is about a certificate or document. Student Services can explain the application process and timelines.

Faculty_Department.reply: You are asking about a faculty member or department. The relevant department office can share contact details.

Cafeteria_Food.reply: This is about the cafeteria or mess. Cafeteria management can share timings, menu and payment options.

Location_Directions.reply: You are asking about the location or directions. The front desk or the college website has the address and campus map.

Library_Facilities.reply: This is a library query. The librarian can help with membership, issue rules and resources.

Attendance_Leave.reply: This is about attendance or leave. Please contact your class coordinator for leave and attendance rules.

Complaint_Support.reply: This looks like a complaint or support request. The IT Helpdesk or Grievance Cell can help you.

Out_of_Scope.reply: Sorry, I can only help with college-related questions such as admission, fees, exams, hostel, transport and placements.
